caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate teapot centered within a rectangular frame outlined on a cream-colored background. The teapot has a rounded, bulbous body and sits on a small, circular base. It features an elongated spout curving upward to the left and a large, upright handle on the right, which is shaded darker than the rest of the teapot. The main surface of the teapot is adorned with detailed, symmetrical floral and scrollwork engravings. The lid of the teapot has additional ornamentation and is topped with a small, rounded knob. The drawing is rendered in pencil or graphite, with areas of denser shading to indicate metallic reflections and the three-dimensional form of the teapot. No other objects appear in the composition.
title: Silver Teapot
